applies_to: Neptronic TUUB universal wall-mount controllers for fan coils, heat pumps, VFDs and zone heating/cooling.
summary: A wall-mount universal room controller with configurable inputs and outputs that speaks BACnet MS/TP. The BACnet guide lists 276 objects: inputs and outputs, mode, fan and occupancy commands, setpoints, demands per ramp, alarms and a large set of Cfg_ configuration objects. Which outputs and modes are used depends on how the ramps and inputs are configured.
notes: Objects marked Present Value in the W? column are writable; AV 1, AV 9, AV 73, MV 13 are commandable (priority array).
Inputs can be overridden by setting Out_of_Service; they return to normal after the time in Device proprietary property #1002 (default 15 min).
SystemMode (MSV.1) options depend on BV.3, BV.21, BV.98 and MSV.20; read State_Text from the device.

NsbOccCommand (MSV.13) has 4 states when an input is set to Occupancy or Night Setback (1 Locally, 2 Off, 3 Occupancy/Day, 4 No Occupancy/Night), otherwise 3 (1 Off, 2 Occupancy/Day, 3 No Occupancy/Night).
Object names are listed as printed, including the odd spaces (for example "AL_ DirtyFilter").
The program (PGM.1) and file (FIL.1) objects used for firmware updates are listed as type Other and FILE.

integration.summary: Command occupancy with MSV.13 NsbOccCommand, the mode with MSV.1 and the fan with MSV.2, and write the setpoint to AV.9. To feed the room temperature from the BMS, set MSV.21 to Network and keep writing AV.1 ControlTemp within the AV.2 timeout. Read MSV.14, AV.1, the ramp demands and the AL_ alarm BVs.

minimum_points.name: NsbOccCommand
minimum_points.why: BMS occupancy command: local, off, occupied, unoccupied

minimum_points.name: SystemMode
minimum_points.why: Mode: auto, heating, cooling, fan, off

minimum_points.name: UserFanSpeedSelect
minimum_points.why: Fan speed: auto, low, medium, high

integration.enable: MSV.13 NsbOccCommand: Locally lets the controller follow its occupancy input; the other states force off, occupied/day or unoccupied/night from the BMS.
integration.heartbeat: With MSV.21 Cfg_TempControlSource = Network, the BMS must keep writing AV.1 ControlTemp; if nothing arrives for AV.2 Cfg_NetworkTimeOut (0-60 min) the controller goes to OFF and AV.1 shows 999 °C in fault. With AV.2 = 0, AV.1 resets to the AV.9 setpoint.
integration.remote_sensors: Set MSV.21 Cfg_TempControlSource to Network (1) and write the room temperature to AV.1 ControlTemp (commandable).
setup: MAC address 0-254 (default 000) from the menu or Device proprietary property #1000; device instance defaults to 153000 + MAC.
BV.1 Cfg_TempUnitBACnet selects Celsius or Fahrenheit for BACnet values.
gotchas: Relinquish defaults of commandable setpoints are saved to non-volatile memory.
COV subscriptions are lost on a power cycle.
